key_insight: Improved multiplication-to-QFT constructions remove a logarithmic overhead, yielding an exact quantum Fourier transform with O(q log q) gates.
engineering_relevance: Lower QFT gate counts could reduce logical circuit costs for phase estimation and Shor-style algorithms, though hardware-level savings are not established.
method: Convert an O(n(log n)^α)-gate integer multiplication circuit into an O(q(log q)^α)-gate exact QFT.
Improve approximate QFT complexity to O(q(log log(q/ε))^α), removing one power of the nested logarithm.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical asymptotic gate-count improvements over prior constructions, not experimental benchmarks or hardware evaluations.
watch_item: Practical benefits depend on multiplication-circuit realizations and compilation overhead; sub-O(q log q) exact QFT remains conditional on faster multiplication.
paper_title: Improved Exact and Approximate Quantum Fourier Transforms from Multiplication
